The supplied loop advances B by 2,048 bytes and packed A by 128 bytes per K step, so these offsets target K+2. Measure the full timed `gemm`, including both prefetch instructions and their guard, under the unchanged correctness, paired-control, repeat, and holdout gates.
risks: Prefetch may add instruction and branch cost, evict useful data, or have no effect. The earlier distance-4 prefetch result was for the inactive full512 NN path and regressed in its supplied measurements; it does not predict this active panel32 experiment.
